hero_description: LITERA helps you analyze digital content from text, links, videos, and audio, so you can make smarter decisions in an information-saturated world.
multiple_description: From viral posts to voice notes, LITERA helps you analyze and verify information across different formats.
text_description: Paste or type any text content
about_meta: Learn about LITERA, its human-centered AI approach, analysis workflow, and technologies supporting digital content verification.
about_intro: LITERA is designed to help people understand digital information by combining AI-powered analysis and available evidence checking in one understandable workflow.
about_quote: AI helps analyze. People still decide what to believe.
human_title_2: You still decide what to believe.
human_description_1: LITERA keeps people at the center of the decision-making process. The system helps identify patterns, understand language, surface claims, and examine available evidence.
human_description_2: This approach positions AI as a reasoning aid rather than a replacement for human judgment.
how_description: Content in different formats passes through extraction, analysis, and verification before the result is presented to the user.
input_description: Submit text, a link, or upload a video or audio file.
extract_description: Content is extracted and audio or video is transcribed into text.
analyze_description: Language and content intent are analyzed using NLP and IndoBERT.
verify_description: Claims are checked against available fact-checking information.
understand_description: Analysis results, claims, evidence, status, and recommendations are presented to the user.
technology_description: Several components work together to transform different forms of digital content into understandable analysis results.
whisper_description: Used to help transcribe audio and video content into text that can be analyzed.
indobert_description: Used for language analysis and content intent classification.
factcheck_description: Used to retrieve and compare available fact-checking information related to claims.
fastapi_description: Acts as the processing backend connecting the analysis workflow and AI components.
project_title: LITERA (Literacy Intelligence for Trusted and Ethical Reasoning Analysis)
project_description: A Human-Centered Artificial Intelligence-based content verification innovation toward an ethical and sustainable digital ecosystem.
cta_title: Better information starts with a check.
footer_description: A digital content analysis platform that helps you understand information before trusting or sharing it.
contact_description: Have a question, feedback, or want to learn more about LITERA?
